name: room
text: Room opened — goal: power: Raise EXCAVA's capability by even 0.5%: find new tools, best/newest models, combine elemen

name: Gearbox
text: Add InstantX-ComfyUI’s depth-aware upscaler to EXCAVA’s pipeline first. It regenerates detail in low-resolution frames without blurring edges, which directly boosts output sharpness—a 0.5%+ gain in perceived quality. The trade-off is a 10-15% slowdown in render time, but EXCAVA’s current bottleneck is output fidelity, not speed.

name: Torque
text: Depth-aware upscaling won’t fix EXCAVA’s face fidelity drop because it targets resolution, not identity—faces still degrade when the base model hallucinates features. Instead, swap RealVisXL v1.1’s face model for a fine-tuned SDXL variant trained on real portraits; it preserves identity better than synthetic sets. Run a blind A/B test: 50 faces, measure ID retention vs. sharpness—if the new model scores higher on both, adopt it.
